methodology.prior_source: recorded corpus over the same window and mode (segment-independent); 0.5 when the corpus window is below segment_min_decided

notes: Folded 1227 decks over min_battles into 2 archetypes by their stamped label, sorted by who plays them (players, then battles); share is of the 5739 decided battles those decks hold. cards_archetype({ name }) says what one of these labels MEANS - its family, its win conditions, the other names for the shape - and cards_archetype({ cards }) names a deck you hand it. players sums the decks' distinct players, so a player on two decks of one shape counts twice. No win rate is shrunk or ranked here: the same label wins and loses with the player.

These are the population's decks and levels; nothing here checks what any one player holds. Before naming a row as a recommendation to a person, pass fit_for with their tag: rows they cannot field leave decks[], and every row then says what they would field it at and what upgrades would open.

archetype is Elixir's descriptive name for a deck's shape - its win condition and family, composed from the cards and their costs - not a claim about what players call it or how it performs; several deck identities (forms) share one label, and a deck with no attested win condition is named by its cost alone.

archetype 'Evo Royal Hogs bridge spam' resolved to bridge spam with Royal Hogs (label); the filter ran over all 47133 decks over min_battles, and decided_battles and usage_share stay the population's.

Pooled across modes: ranked 363004 (mean level gap +0.00), casual 9886 (mean level gap +0.00), war 8824 (mean level gap +0.00), ladder 8356 (mean level gap +0.00), tournament 3640 (mean level gap +0.00); pass mode to isolate one.
Pooled player-battle observations, not unique matches: both participants can contribute, so counts are dependent.
Only decided head-to-head battles count; `excluded` says how many duels, boat battles, draws and unresolved outcomes the window held.
shrunk_win_rate shrinks toward the CORPUS mean over the same window and mode, and is withheld below 30 decided observations (insufficient_sample: true).
Shrinkage moderates extremes but does not adjust for skill or guarantee rank order; no confidence intervals.
